user.title: Connect Fish Live3
user.description: Enter your Fish Audio API key from the Fish developer console. This is an unofficial personal project provided as is, without warranty or guaranteed support. You are responsible for API charges. It creates a separate assistant and never changes existing voice pipelines. Live3 speaks English. Browser/Windows conversations are full duplex; existing ESPHome satellites use turn-taking compatibility mode.

error.invalid_auth: Fish rejected this API key. Check the key and its access to Agents.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Fish Agents API. Check connectivity and try again.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Fish Live3 is already configured. Use its Configure button to change the API key or voice.

init.title: Fish Live3 settings
init.description: Leave the API key blank to keep your existing key. It stays in Home Assistant and is never included in the dashboard or Windows app.
